name: BabyLoveGrowth
summary: AI SEO/GEO content automation — auto-publishes optimized articles, builds backlinks and runs keyword research, aimed at fast hands-off organic growth for lean teams.
best_for: solo founders and lean startups who want hands-off SEO content velocity fast, are comfortable with AI-generated articles at scale, and value the 90-day guarantee as a safety net
skip_if: you're building a long-term brand where a spam-update hit would hurt, or you operate in a YMYL/regulated niche where thin AI content is genuinely risky — human-in-the-loop tools fit better there
honest_knock: The honest concern here isn't the price — it's the model, and the guarantee that is supposed to cover you if the model fails. Auto-publishing 30 to 120 AI articles a month while swapping backlinks with 4,000 other member sites is exactly the scaled-content-and-reciprocal-links pattern Google's spam policies are written to catch, and the vendor's own FAQ describes the exchange in those terms: your site places links for others as theirs place links for you. It can lift metrics short-term; on a brand you're building for years, it's a real durability risk. The 90-day money-back guarantee used to offset some of that, and we can no longer say it does: the plan cards promise it, and the FAQ on the same page says no refunds are given after the three-day trial ends. Ask for those terms in writing before you pay for a year.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (prices re-verified 2026-09-19 on babylovegrowth.ai/en/pricing from a European connection, where it prices in euros) Two plans and a Monthly/Yearly toggle that swaps the amounts. Paid monthly, Grow is €99 a month and Scale €399, each shown against a struck-through €247 and €599. Switch to "Pay yearly · save 25%" and the same cards read €75 and €291 a month, labelled "Billed yearly"; the page prints no annual total. Grow carries 30 branded AEO/SEO articles a month, 10 AI prompts tracked daily across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, $800+ a month in backlinks from the 4,000-site partner network, auto-publishing to WordPress, Shopify and eight more CMSs, a technical GEO audit, Reddit and Quora agents, automated keyword research, one seat and email support. Scale carries 120 articles across four languages, 50 prompts tracked, $1,600+ a month in higher-DR backlinks, unlimited seats, priority same-day support, a dedicated 1-on-1 SEO/GEO specialist and monthly reporting with a human. Both start on a 3-day free trial. The cards promise 90 days money back, but the FAQ on the same page says no refunds are given once the three-day trial ends. The feature table below the cards keeps showing €99/mo and €399/mo in both toggle settings. History: on 5 September we read Scale at €224 a month billed €2,691 a year, and its plan text then added a specialist and extra languages but no extra articles or backlink budget; both the price and the contents have changed since.

compare_with.name: Frase
compare_with.why: Frase keeps a human in the loop — AI that assists writing you still edit and own; BabyLoveGrowth goes full-automation for pure velocity. The trade-off is speed now versus durability against Google's next spam update
